svg.text: Stays --var (params alone cannot tell): mcmicro SINGLE_SEGMENTER, epitopeprediction SINGLE_PREDICTOR / NO_VARIANT_INPUT, chipseq PRESEQ_RAN. Output introspection (phylogeny, pplacer, metadata file) still runs after the rules.
